*[[2023 Turkey–Syria earthquake]]
**The death toll from the [[List of earthquakes in Turkey|earthquakes]] in [[Turkey]] increases to 43,850, as the [[World Health Organization]] declares northwestern [[Syria]] as the zone of greatest concern, citing the slow delivery of [[humanitarian aid]]. '''Health and environment'''
*[[Climate change in Antarctica]]
**The [[National Snow and Ice Data Center]] of the [[United States]] reports that the [[Antarctic sea ice]] decreased to {{convert|1.91|e6km2|sqmi|sp=us}} within the week, the smallest remaining ice area since records began in 1979. [https://news.abs-cbn.com/overseas/02/17/23/antarctica-sea-ice-melts-to-a-record-low (AFP via ABS-CBN News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*A [[Da Nang]] [[Judicial system of Vietnam|court]] [[Sentence (law)|sentences]] four [[Koreans in Vietnam|South Korean]] men to imprisonment for [[People smuggling|smuggling]] around 200 South Koreans into [[Vietnam]] during the [[COVID-19 pandemic in Vietnam|COVID-19 pandemic]] when the country [[COVID-19 lockdowns|suspended the entry of all foreigners]] from 2020 to 2021. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2023/02/16/Vietnam-jails-South-Koreans-for-people-smuggling-during-pandemic- (AFP via Al Arabiya)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Russia in the Council of Europe]]
**Lawmakers in the [[State Duma]] vote to withdraw [[Russia]] from 21 conventions of the [[Council of Europe]]. [https://www.rferl.org/a/russia-council-of-europe-conventions-exit/32274317.html (RFE/RL)]
*The [[Government of Portugal|Portuguese government]] announces the end of the [[Portugal Golden Visa]] [[Immigrant investor programs|investor program]], as well as a ban on new licenses for [[Airbnb]]s, due to a severe [[Housing gap|housing shortage]] and rising [[Renting|rents]]. [https://www.reuters.com/markets/europe/portugal-ends-golden-visas-curtails-airbnb-rentals-address-housing-crisis-2023-02-16/ (Reuters)] 

'''Sports'''
*[[2022–23 FIS Alpine Ski World Cup]]
**[[FIS Alpine World Ski Championships 2023]]
***American [[Alpine skiing|alpine skier]] [[Mikaela Shiffrin]] wins her seventh career [[FIS Alpine World Ski Championships|alpine world championships]] gold medal in the [[FIS Alpine World Ski Championships 2023 – Women's giant slalom|women's giant slalom]] of the [[FIS Alpine World Ski Championships 2023|2023 edition]] in the [[French Alps]], making her the most successful skier in the modern era with an overall tally of 13 medals from 16 career world championship races.
